all_resources:
SELECT r.ResourceID,COUNT(l.LoanID) AS TotalLoans,
COUNT(CASE WHEN l.ReturnDate IS NULL THEN l.LoanID END) AS ActiveLoans
FROM Resource r LEFT JOIN Loan l ON r.ResourceID=l.ResourceID
GROUP BY r.ResourceID ORDER BY r.ResourceID;
active_labels:
SELECT m.MemberID,m.Name || ' / ' || r.Label AS LoanLabel,c.Name AS Category
FROM Member m INNER JOIN Loan l ON m.MemberID=l.MemberID
INNER JOIN Resource r ON l.ResourceID=r.ResourceID
INNER JOIN Category c ON r.CategoryID=c.CategoryID
WHERE l.ReturnDate IS NULL ORDER BY m.MemberID,r.ResourceID;
